title: Greater Flexibility for Disbursement of Government Financial Assistance Funds during COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Greater Flexibility for Disbursement of Government Financial Assistance Funds during COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: ComCare COVID-19 assistance increase
sections.summary: The Government added $60 million to ComCare under the Resilience Budget, bringing FY2020 ComCare budget to about $240 million, with higher SSO approvals and automatic six-month extensions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As the global economic situation rapidly deteriorated as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Government committed another $60 million for increased ComCare flexibility under the Resilience Budget in March.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In sum, the total budget for ComCare in FY2020 is about $240 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In April this year, SSOs approved 125 applications for ComCare Interim Assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This is higher than the monthly average of 72 approved applications in the preceding six months from October 2019 to March 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since April 2020, SSOs have been providing at least six months of assistance to new recipients of ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term Assistance (SMTA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In April this year, SSOs approved 1,441 applications with six months of assistance or longer, which is higher than the monthly average of 946 approved applications with six months of assistance or longer in the preceding six months, from October 2019 to March 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Households who are already on ComCare will also have their assistance automatically extended for a further six months without them having to approach the SSOs.

sections.label: ComCare income eligibility criteria
sections.summary: ComCare SMTA and Interim Assistance require monthly household income of $1,900 and below or per capita household income of $650 and below.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: ComCare SMTA and Interim Assistance have income eligibility criteria of a monthly household income of $1,900 and below or per capita household income of $650 and below.
